Data Associate

  • Successful hires will support our machine learning team by processing and organizing scientific datasets relevant to drug discovery and development. Candidates should have an undergraduate degree in a STEM field, hands-on experience in a Linux environment, and familiarity with Python and SQL. Experience handling large-scale datasets, structuring data from diverse sources, and cataloging metadata to facilitate data discovery and maintain accurate data provenance is highly desirable. This is a two-year position with full benefits.

    The expected annual base salary for this role is $170,000–$210,000. Our compensation package includes variable compensation in the form of sign-on and year-end bonuses, as well as generous benefits, including relocation and immigration assistance. The final salary will be determined based on multiple factors, including prior experience and educational background. We follow a hybrid work schedule, with employees working in-office from Tuesday through Thursday and having the option to work remotely on Monday and Friday.

Desktop and Server Technician

  • Successful hires will be responsible for managing the setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Mac and Windows desktop computers/laptops and Linux servers, as well as conference room setups and wired/wireless network infrastructure, in our New York City offices. Relevant candidates may have a technical background in desktop support, Linux systems administration, server maintenance, audio/visual systems, network infrastructure, and/or computer programming. Some background in technology support, hardware inventory management, end user support, or project planning is desirable but not required. Ideal candidates will excel at working independently, problem-solving, and communicating effectively with engineers and managers located in other offices. We will consider candidates at all levels of experience, including entry-level applicants; junior candidates seeking opportunities for growth are welcome to apply.

    The expected annual base salary for this position is $90,000–$190,000. Our compensation package also includes variable compensation in the form of sign-on and year-end bonuses, and generous benefits, including relocation and immigration assistance. The applicable annual base salary paid to a successful applicant will be determined based on multiple factors including the nature and extent of prior experience and educational background. The hire for this role would be expected to work from the NYC offices five days a week.
